q2_onceTheSlotIsShared.whichEntry: MEASURED (after S0-S8): the socket side finds the create route's entry: one registry (sameRegistryInstance true, slot present, slot === socket-graph getCampaignHostRegistry()), one entry object (sameEntryObject true), builtBy api-graph, participants retained on it (the guest at S1, the GM live at S3), paused false until the GM's first connection and after.
q2_onceTheSlotIsShared.whichSemanticsWin: The created (not rebuilt) semantics win for a live session, and they are the code's own stated design: CampaignSyncSession.ts:312-315 ("A freshly CREATED session does not call this. The GM is the one creating it and their socket follows immediately, and starting that case paused would refuse a guest who arrives in between") and CampaignHostRegistry.test.ts:200-210 "creates a fresh campaign UNPAUSED". The baseline's start-paused was the split's artefact: the socket graph never saw the created entry, so every live session went through the rebuild path meant for a restart or an eviction (CampaignHostRegistry.ts:384-386). Rebuilt semantics still apply when getOrCreate finds no entry (a process restart empties the slot; dispose removes an entry).
q2_onceTheSlotIsShared.usableAsIs: Same shape (one class, ICampaignHostRegistryEntry) and the same host, session, arbiter and journal the players then talk to. One exception, MEASURED: the entry's progression readers resolve the process match store by class identity (campaignProgressionReaders.durable.ts:92, `store instanceof DurableMatchStore`). The match store sits in a globalThis slot (getDefaultMatchStore.ts:31-33) constructed by the socket graph at boot (server.js:537 -> MatchHostRegistry.ts:69); live, instanceofSocketGraphDurableMatchStore true and instanceofApiGraphDurableMatchStore false at every step. An API-built entry therefore reads no correction saga, and the AdvanceDay gate's correction-pending clause goes dark (MEASURED with mutant M5: saga null, gate ok:true with a source-recorded saga seeded; with the fix: correction-pending).
q2_onceTheSlotIsShared.readerDecision: Fixed in this unit (src/lib/multiplayer/server, in the ownership path): matchStoreDbOrNull reads the store's getDatabase method instead of its class (+13/-3 lines), with a red-first jest row. Without it the unit would ship a regression of the socket-side AdvanceDay gate (today the socket builds its own entry, whose readers match the store's class). The same fix also un-darkens the API-graph launch route's saga read (campaignLaunchAuthorityRoute.ts:188), which reads the same way on the baseline (a pre-existing defect, measured only as the instanceof false, not driven through that route). The parent may split it out; without it U95 should not ship.

q4_liveMeasurement.what: A Node-inspector read of both module graphs of a standalone server running this worktree's build (no repository edit, no probe route), during a scripted co-op session; see method. Measured on the baseline build (split) and on the after build (shared); both outputs verbatim in u95-red-20260926.json and u95-local-20260926.json.
method: Scratch driver <lane-temp>/u95-live-driver.cjs (outside the repository, not committed): starts `node --inspect=127.0.0.1:<inspectPort> server.js` from the worktree with NODE_ENV=production, HOSTNAME=127.0.0.1 (process-scoped), PORT=<port>, NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_MODE=true, PLAYWRIGHT_E2E_RUN_ID=u95-live-<label>, MULTIPLAYER_STORE=durable and MULTIPLAYER_DB_PATH/DATABASE_PATH in a fresh temp dir; waits for /__playwright_e2e_ready__?runId=<id> 204.

Drives one co-op session over the real routes: PUT /api/campaigns/<id> (envelope shape of e2e/helpers/campaignJournalDrive.ts campaignEnvelope), POST /api/multiplayer/matches with coopCampaign and the GM bearer token (identities minted with issuePlayerToken, as campaignIdentity does), then campaign sockets (channel=campaign, CampaignJoin, as e2e/helpers/campaignJournalSocket.ts does): guest joins by room code before the GM; guest CampaignProposal; GM joins; guest proposal; GM socket closes; guest proposal; GM reconnects; guest proposal.

At every step one read-only Runtime.evaluate over the inspector reads: the socket graph (Module._cache entry for src/lib/multiplayer/server/CampaignHostRegistry.ts, getCampaignHostRegistry()) and Next API graph (.next/server/webpack-api-runtime.js, the webpack module whose factory contains "Campaign snapshot rejected: ", its only export = getCampaignHostRegistry in this build; that module is async, so its exports sit under Symbol(webpack exports)); per graph the entry for the match: paused, gmConnections, retained participants (acknowledged/delivered), live participants, and which graph built its CampaignMatchHost (instanceof each graph's class); === of the two registries and entries; whether the globalThis slot exists; and whether the process match store (globalThis Symbol.for('mekstation.multiplayer.matchStore')) is an instance of each graph's DurableMatchStore.

S9 (after the proposal steps, driver revision used for after/M4/M5): seeds one campaign_combat_outcome_inbox row on the run's own journal file and one source-recorded coordinated correction saga on the run's own match-store file, then asks each registry's entry for readSagaForCampaign and evaluateScenarioLaunch (the AdvanceDay gate).
The server is killed with taskkill /T /F at the end; liveness re-checked with Get-Process.

q5_rebuiltPausedBehaviourAGmSees.baselineMeasured: S1-S2: the socket side's own entry is rebuilt and paused (paused true, gmConnections 0) until the GM's first connection; a guest proposal gets Error frame { code: MATCH_PAUSED, reason: campaign-paused-gm-absent } (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:652-668). S3: the GM joins, receives CampaignSnapshot (CampaignSnapshotPublished), paused false. S5-S6: GM socket closes -> paused true; guest proposal -> MATCH_PAUSED campaign-paused-gm-absent. S7: GM returns -> CampaignSnapshot then the pending CampaignDecision frame, paused false. S8: guest proposal processed (CampaignDecision).
q5_rebuiltPausedBehaviourAGmSees.afterMeasured: S1-S2: the shared created entry is NOT paused before the GM's first connection; the guest proposal is processed (CampaignDecision status mechanically-rejected: the probe proposal is deliberately malformed, which is how the arbiter answers when not paused). S3-S8 identical to the baseline: GM loss pauses (MATCH_PAUSED campaign-paused-gm-absent), GM return resumes, the GM receives CampaignSnapshot on return.
q5_rebuiltPausedBehaviourAGmSees.whatAGmSeesOnReturn: Unchanged: on return the GM receives CampaignSnapshot (CampaignSnapshotPublished) and pending proposals/decisions; the pause lifts on their connection. The only change a tester can see is before the GM first connects to a session created in this process: a guest's mutating command is processed instead of refused MATCH_PAUSED.
